fields.System.Title: INB-302 — Suggest a destination using a simple rule
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a putaway operator, I want the system to tell me where to put the stock, so that I
do not have to decide for every pallet.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a putaway task, then a destination is suggested: the first active location with
  • room that satisfies the product's zone, temperature, and hazmat constraints.
  • - Given no suitable location exists, then the task is flagged for a supervisor rather
  • than suggesting an illegal one.
  • - Given the suggestion, then it is advisory — the operator may choose otherwise, subject
  • to [INB-304](INB-304-override-suggested-location.md).
  • - Given this rule, then it is deliberately simple and is replaced by
  • [INB-305](INB-305-capacity-and-zone-rules.md) at Stage 3.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inbound, masterdata |
| Tables | putaway_task, location |
| Risks | Null capacity making the rule unusable ([doc 03 §7.4](../../../docs/03-master-data.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
